title: Sleep, Focus and Good Evenings
summary: Ama and Carlos talk about why sleep matters for concentration and how to build a calmer evening routine.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama and Carlos sitting on a sofa in a dim living room with a lamp, a book and a cup of tea, a crescent moon in the window, no text

sentences.text: Carlos, you look exhausted today. Did you sleep badly again?
Yes, I only slept five hours. I was answering emails until midnight.
That explains why you could not concentrate in the meeting this morning.
Exactly. I read the same paragraph three times and understood nothing.
Research suggests that tired people make more mistakes and remember less.
I know, but I always tell myself that I will catch up at the weekend.
Unfortunately, you cannot repay a sleep debt so easily.
That is a depressing thought. What do you recommend, then?
Start with a fixed bedtime, even on Saturdays, so your body learns a rhythm.
It sounds sensible, although I will probably find it difficult at first.

quiz.explain: I was answering emails until midnight.

quiz.q: What does Ama say about a sleep debt?
quiz.explain: Unfortunately, you cannot repay a sleep debt so easily.
Start with a fixed bedtime, even on Saturdays.

sentences.text: Let us talk about the evenings. I usually scroll on my phone until I fall asleep.
That is a common habit, but the bright screen keeps your brain alert.
So should I switch the phone off completely?
Try to put it in another room an hour before bed, and read a paper book instead.
An hour is a long time. What should I do with it?
Prepare your clothes for tomorrow, stretch a little, or simply drink a warm tea.
I like that idea. It would also reduce the stress of the morning.
Exactly. A short routine tells your mind that the day is over.
Fine, I will try it for two weeks and tell you the result.
Good luck. I expect you will notice a difference within a few days.

quiz.q: Why is a bright screen a problem before bed?
quiz.explain: The bright screen keeps your brain alert.

quiz.q: What does Ama suggest instead of scrolling?
How long will Carlos try the new routine?
quiz.explain: I will try it for two weeks.
